title: Upgrade React Native 0.73 → 0.74: deprecated StatusBar props removed
prompt: React Native 0.74 removed the deprecated `barStyle` and `backgroundColor` props from the `StatusBar` component (they now live on `useColorScheme` + the theme). After the upgrade, src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx still passes `barStyle="dark-content"` and `backgroundColor="#fff"` to `<StatusBar>`, which no longer typechecks against RN 0.74 types. Rewrite the component so the StatusBar uses no deprecated props (drop them or use the `useColorScheme`-driven theme), keeping the screen functional. Return each changed file with its complete new content.
